name: TALIWRK
recent: Taliworks 在 2026 年 11 月 26 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的季度业绩，新闻标题显示第三季净利同比下滑 27%，但营收因收费公路补偿而上升，同时股息被暂停。公司此前在 2025 年 11 月宣布的第三次中期股息（每股 0.5 仙）已于 2025 年 12 月派发。
notable: 公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的业绩。
此前宣布的第三次中期股息每股 0.5 仙已于 2025 年 12 月 24 日派发。
risks: 新闻标题显示第三季净利同比下滑 27%，且股息被暂停。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 129,945,000 令吉，环比增长 9.0%，同比增长 16.0%；净利为 11,493,000 令吉，环比增长 27.7%，但同比下降 14.5%；净利率为 8.8%，高于上一季度的 7.6%。

recent_en: Taliworks released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 26 November 2026, with news headlines indicating Q3 net profit fell 27% year-on-year while revenue rose due to toll compensation, and the dividend was suspended. The third interim dividend of 0.5 sen per share announced in November 2025 was paid in December 2025.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
The previously announced third interim dividend of 0.5 sen per share was paid on 24 December 2025.
risks_en: News headlines indicate Q3 net profit fell 27% year-on-year and the dividend was suspended.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 129,945,000, up 9.0% quarter-on-quarter and 16.0% year-on-year; net income was MYR 11,493,000, up 27.7% quarter-on-quarter but down 14.5% year-on-year; net margin was 8.8%, higher than 7.6% in the previous quarter.
